overview_description.description: Archil is a software company that develops cloud storage software that enables organizations to access and manage large datasets through a file system interface backed by object storage services. Its platform converts storage environments such as Amazon S3 into POSIX-compatible disks that behave like local file systems while maintaining the scalability of cloud storage. The company provides tools that allow users to mount, share, and interact with data across servers without requiring traditional data transfers or infrastructure provisioning. Its solution incorporates a high-speed caching layer that improves performance and supports workloads such as artificial intelligence model training, analytics, and data processing. Archil also enables execution of compute tasks directly on stored data, reducing the need for separate compute resources and simplifying workflows. The platform integrates with multiple storage providers and synchronizes data between environments to maintain consistency. Its offerings are used by teams that require efficient access to large volumes of unstructured data across distributed systems.
